critique: The quotient/right-inverse identification theorem and nuisance-minimax equality are delivered, but the exact local minimax law and adaptive inference frontier at endpoint kinks remain open. The finite-sample procedure is an honest outer-set construction with excess width of order sqrt(log n/n), whereas the converse is only a root-n lower bound on regular faces, so the note does not establish a matched inference frontier. Computation remains exponential in the substantive arm and target cardinalities, and the supporting evidence is limited to one analytically certified low-cardinality witness without an implementation or applied demonstration. The claimed strict extension of Gabriel et al. also relies on an uncited scope lemma lacking exact theorem or page references, which weakens the literature comparison's auditability. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
